environmentBoundary: VERIFY_* are inherited from the managed host process at module import; the public command runtime has no per-call env option. Defaults are unchanged upstream prechecks; their domain-specific textual rejection rules are not a universal correctness test.
durability: Project nonblocking flock; started/ended request journals; per-file atomic snapshot publication, not multi-file transactions or exactly-once. Unsettled mutation IDs require reconciliation. Completed same-payload retries return saved response. OS ownership and exclusion of external filesystem writers are required.
receipt: sha256 of compact UTF-8 sorted-key JSON {context,arguments}; predecessors map IDs to canonical Markdown file sha256. No signature/authentication: trusted backend only. Full supplied arguments (including omitted-vs-explicit optional fields) are bound; duplicate predecessors rejected. verifierSessionId is a safe 1-128 character identifier; report issues and gaps both contain {location,issue}.
